corridor_notes: Xuzhou connecting/liaison line (徐州联络线) of the 苏皖豫干线 project. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '联络线起自干线睢宁分输站，止于江苏省徐州市徐州联络站，长87.33公里，管径508毫米' (starts at Suining Distribution Station on the main trunk, ends at Xuzhou Liaison Station in Xuzhou City; 87.33 km, DN508mm, 6.3 MPa). PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice and GEM both give 86.0 km for this segment (pre-final-design figure); the line runs entirely within Xuzhou prefecture, Jiangsu, connecting the main-trunk take-off point near Suining County to a liaison station in Xuzhou city proper.
researcher_notes: Matches GEM's StartLocation 'Suining' exactly (睢宁 Suining County, Xuzhou). Both endpoints confirmed identically by two independent official sources (MEE approval + PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice); a third source (bidding notice at caizhaowang.com) gives a slightly different length (86.7 km) for the same segment, consistent with pre-final-design variance rather than a different route.
blockers: Neither station name resolves in OSM/Nominatim directly; used county centroid (Suining) and city centroid (Xuzhou) as fallbacks. A human GIS pass against the full EIA report could refine to exact station coordinates.
